description: Per-item-type capability matrix: what fabio can do to a Fabric item type (creatable, definition API support, CI/CD deploy strategy, deploy order). Omit the type for the full matrix. Derived at runtime from the CLI's own sources — no hand-maintained registry, so it never drifts.

deploy_strategy.content: fabio deploy exports and pushes a versionable definition; fully round-trippable.
deploy_strategy.platform_only: fabio deploy creates a shell (.platform + creationPayload) only — no versionable definition content.
deploy_strategy.unsupported: Not in fabio's deploy order; cannot be created/updated by fabio deploy (portal-only or auto-provisioned).

legend.creatable: fabio exposes a create/create-* command for this type.
legend.supports_definition: fabio exposes get-definition/update-definition (the API definition axis). A type may support the definition API yet still deploy as a shell (platform_only) when the definition carries no versionable content, e.g. Lakehouse.
legend.deployable_from_definition: fabio deploy can recreate this item from an exported definition (== content strategy). The CI/CD 'verified' axis.
legend.deploy_order: 0-based position in fabio's dependency-ordered deploy sequence (null when unsupported).
legend.derivation: Derived at runtime from known item types + definition specs + schema definition_format + DEPLOY_ORDER + commands.json. No hand-maintained registry — change the source and the matrix follows.

notes: Two INDEPENDENT axes. `supports_definition` (get/update-definition API) is distinct from `deploy_strategy`: e.g. Lakehouse supports the definition API but deploys as a shell (platform_only, supports_definition=true, deployable_from_definition=false), while Warehouse has no definition API at all (supports_definition=false). Use this BEFORE deploy/export/update-definition so an agent doesn't attempt an unsupported operation. The full matrix (no TYPE arg) returns {item_capabilities:[...], count, legend}. Scorecard is NOT here — it's a Power BI Goals artifact, not a Fabric item (fabio scorecard ...).
